items.title: Europe will take part in US-mediated Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, French FM says
items.description: France will participate in the upcoming Abu Dhabi peace talks on ending the Ukraine war, Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said Sunday, adding that Europeans will be represented at the summit. The talks will take place under US mediation on Tuesday and Wednesday.

items.title: Europe will be represented at US-mediated Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi
items.description: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said Europe will be represented in scheduled talks on Tuesday and Wednesday aimed at ending the war in Ukraine.

items.title: Ukraine: Russia hits Kyiv with airstrikes ahead of trilateral talks
items.description: The strikes hit a major bridge and energy facilities in the Kyiv region. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused Moscow of trying to "push" Ukraine "into a blackout" ahead of talks in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Ukraine Hopes Oleshky Can Serve As Model For Wider Truce, Delegation Says In DC
items.description: Ukraine hopes a temporary cease-fire that enabled humanitarian aid deliveries and civilian evacuations from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky could serve as a model for wider de-escalation efforts, Ukrainian officials said on November 6.

items.title: In southern Lebanon, caught between war and peace
items.description: Despite a ceasefire deal reached earlier this year, the Israeli military still occupies a large swath of southern Lebanon.

items.title: World News in Brief: Civilians killed in DR Congo, Ukrainians wrestle with return, Guterres calls out ‘normalisation’ of force
items.description: At least 30 civilians were killed overnight on Thursday in Beni Territory, North Kivu in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to local sources cited by the UN aid coordination office (OCHA).

items.title: Trump Meets Privately With Putin Envoy After White House Event Marking Oleshky Ceasefire
items.description: The U.S. president did not disclose what he discussed with envoy Kirill Dmitriev, but he predicted a deal to end the war in Ukraine could emerge soon.
